comparison.objective: Pull, wipe, reseat, reread, and finally reseat an engine dipstick; candidate replaces a harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated long-blade extraction/insertion and cloth wiping versus connector unlatching, mating, and cable/seal handling.
comparison.success_condition: PR defines extraction height, seating, grasp, wipe contact and stroke coverage, and ordered history; candidate has no measurable connector rubric.
comparison.reason: Repeated dipstick inspection and wiping test different contact skills and sequencing.
